product_one_liner.value: SpotDraft is an AI-native contract lifecycle management platform for legal teams that brings contract intake, creation, review, negotiation, approvals, e-signatures, and post-signature management into one system.
product_one_liner.notes: SpotDraft’s official AI information page describes an AI-native CLM for legal teams covering the full contract lifecycle, which supports the one-sentence summary.

pricing_page.notes: SpotDraft has a dedicated pricing page describing pricing based on users or contract volume.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The SpotDraft HR product page shows customer logos for Doceree, LambdaTest, Oyster, and Quizlet. | named_customers.0: The page displays Doceree as a customer logo. | named_customers.1: The page displays LambdaTest as a customer logo. | named_customers.2: The page displays Oyster as a customer logo. | named_customers.3: The page displays Quizlet as a customer logo.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The same official headquarters entry identifies the city as Bengaluru. | hq_country: SpotDraft’s official AI information page identifies its headquarters as Bengaluru, India.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering blog index lists multiple posts on how the product is built, including Angular, front-end migration to a monorepo, and Bazel for AI development. The Angular post identifies its author as SpotDraft’s front-end lead; the Bazel technical post also gives an author. This supports a technical blog with multiple engineering-oriented posts.

public_docs.notes: SpotDraft has a developer portal FAQ linking to multiple developer documentation pages and a Help Center with VerifAI FAQs, so it has public product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: SpotDraft’s jobs site lists a Product Manager - AI opening and an application link, so an AI-titled role is open.

model_provider.value: GPT-4 (primary); also GPT-4o, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Bison.
model_provider.notes: SpotDraft’s VerifAI FAQ states GPT-4 is the primary model and names GPT-4o, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Bison as additional models/providers it can use.

raised_18mo.notes: SpotDraft announced an $8 million Series B extension in January 2026, within the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: SpotDraft announced its Claude connector on October 29, 2026; the announcement says customers can connect and query contracts in Claude. This is a product feature launch inside the six-month window.
